jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Kale (Sukuma wiki) production guide

varieties.name: Collard Mfalme
varieties.supplier_notes: Most-planted Kenyan kale variety; bred for repeated pluck-harvest.

varieties.name: Thousand Headed
varieties.supplier_notes: Tall stem, slow bolting; good for upland Rift Valley.

timeline_template.description_en: Sow seed in seedbed at 1cm depth. Water lightly twice daily.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mbegu kitaluni kina 1cm. Mwagilia maji kidogo mara mbili kwa siku.

timeline_template.description_en: Transplant 4-week-old seedlings at 60cm x 45cm. Water immediately.
timeline_template.description_sw: Pandikiza miche wiki 4 nafasi ya 60cm x 45cm. Mwagilia mara moja.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 50kg DAP at transplanting (one tablespoon per hole).
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za DAP wakati wa kupandikiza (kijiko kwa shimo).

timeline_template.description_en: Shallow-hoe between rows; mulch with dry grass.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kwa jembe la juu juu; weka nyasi kavu.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 50kg CAN as side-dress 10cm from plant base.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za CAN 10cm kutoka mmea.

timeline_template.description_en: Scout for diamondback moth and aphids. Spray only if pest threshold exceeded.
timeline_template.description_sw: Tafuta wadudu (diamondback na kunguru). Nyunyuza dawa ikiwa wamezidi.
timeline_template.tip_en: Hand-pick caterpillars at low density to avoid spray costs.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Chukua viwavi kwa mkono ikiwa wachache, ili kuepuka gharama ya dawa.

timeline_template.description_en: Pluck 2-3 outer leaves per plant. Leave the crown intact for regrowth.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chuna majani 2-3 ya nje kwa kila mmea. Acha kichwa cha mmea.
timeline_template.tip_en: Harvest every 7-10 days. A well-tended crop yields 6+ months.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Vuna kila siku 7-10. Mmea ulio na uangalifu mzuri unaweza kuvuna miezi 6+.

timeline_template.description_en: Second 50kg CAN dose to sustain leaf production.
timeline_template.description_sw: Dosi ya pili ya CAN kilo 50 kuendeleza majani.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Bunch by stem length. Reject yellowed or holed leaves.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: Tied bunches of 8-10 leaves; loaded loose in pickup beds.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Sell same-day; refrigerate at 4°C only if overnight delay.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Uza siku hiyohiyo; hifadhi friji 4°C ikiwa lazima kuchelewa usiku.

diseases.symptoms_en: Caterpillars skeletonise leaves from week 5 onward; small holes that join into windows.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Viwavi wanalia majani kuanzia wiki 5; matundu madogo yanakuwa mapana.
diseases.treatment_en: Hand-pick caterpillars at low density — cheaper than spraying. Spray a registered larvicide only when the threshold is exceeded. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Chukua viwavi kwa mkono ikiwa wachache — ni nafuu kuliko dawa. Nyunyuza dawa iliyoidhinishwa tu wakati wamezidi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Scout every 3-4 days from week 5; keep the stand clean.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza kila siku 3-4 kuanzia wiki 5; weka shamba safi.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the leaf underside; frass presence separates DBM from aphids.

diseases.symptoms_en: Sap-suckers that curl new growth; colonies on leaf undersides.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Wanyonya utomvu na kukunja majani machanga; makundi chini ya majani.
diseases.treatment_en: Squash early colonies by hand before they spread; spray registered products only if spreading. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ponda makundi ya mwanzo kwa mkono kabla ya kuenea; nyunyuza tu ikiwa yanaenea. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Check undersides of young leaves weekly.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza chini ya majani machanga kila wiki.
diseases.scanner_notes: Underside photo with the colony visible.

diseases.symptoms_en: Yellow V-shaped lesions at leaf margins, blackened veins, stunting; spreads fast in wet weather.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya manjano yenye umbo la V kwenye kingo za majani, mishipa meusi, mmea dhaifu; husambaa kwa kasi mvua nyingi.
diseases.treatment_en: No cure — remove and destroy infected plants; copper-class products only suppress spread. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze mimea iliyoathirika; dawa za kikundi cha copper zinazuia kuenea tu. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Clean seed, 2-3 year rotation away from brassicas, no overhead irrigation.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mbegu safi, zungusha mashamba miaka 2-3 bila kabichi, usimwagilie majani kutoka juu.
diseases.scanner_notes: V-shaped margin lesions are the signature; photograph the leaf flat.

diseases.symptoms_en: Yellow specks on the upper leaf, grey-purple fuzz below, in cool damp spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya manjano juu ya jani, ukungu wa kijivu chini, wakati wa baridi na unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: Spray a registered downy-active fungicide at first specks. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Nyunyuza dawa iliyoidhinishwa ya ukungu mara madoa yanapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Open spacing for airflow; resistant varieties (Mfalme); water in the morning.
diseases.prevention_sw: Nafasi ya kutosha kwa hewa; aina sugu (Mfalme); mwagilia asubuhi.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the UNDERSIDE — the fuzz is invisible from above.

diseases.symptoms_en: Dark brown spots with rings; centres fall out leaving shot-holes.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kahawia yenye pete; katikati huanguka na kuacha matundu.
diseases.treatment_en: Spray a registered alternaria-active fungicide at first spots. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Nyunyuza dawa iliyoidhinishwa ya alternaria mara madoa yanapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Rotate crops, remove debris, avoid leaf wetness at night.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha mazao, ondoa mabaki, epuka majani kuloweshwa usiku.
diseases.scanner_notes: Ringed spots (target pattern) separate it from downy mildew.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Sell same-day, every week. Kale is the closest thing to weekly income in horticulture — demand never pauses.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Uza siku hiyohiyo, kila wiki. Sukuma wiki ni karibu na mshahara wa kila wiki — soko halipumziki.
market_notes.price_notes_en: Retail ~40–80 KES per kg (Meru/Kirinyaga, November 2026). A planned acre: 9,000–15,000 kg across ~20 picks, sold weekly rather than in one glut.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: Rejareja ~40–80 KES kwa kilo (Meru/Kirinyaga, Novemba 2026). Eka moja iliyopangwa: kilo 9,000–15,000 kwa vivuno ~20, vinauzwa kila wiki.
